title: Juicy Crispy Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A pungent and crispy Syrian dish featuring lamb, tomato ketchup, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine vessel. This low-carb friendly recipe is perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the tomato ketchup, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the tajine vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tajine vessel from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb and sauce hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
